description: A person picks the sign from the door and approaches your establishment, looking for work.
dialogue: "Hello! I'm [event_worker] and I'm looking for work. I'm willing to work hard for fair pay."

choices.option: Hire them immediately for [COST] per day.
choices.message: You seal the deal at [actual_cost]. [event_worker] shakes your hand with a steady smile; the daily cost is [actual_cost], and they start work at once.
After a measured back-and-forth, you settle at [actual_cost] per day, a 20% cut below their preferred rate. [event_worker] accepts with grace.
You thank [event_worker] for their interest but explain you're not hiring right now. They nod understandingly and leave.

description: A muscular figure sits in the corner of your tavern, nursing a drink. Scars crisscross their arms, and their knuckles are split from recent fights. They notice you watching and approach with a confident swagger.
dialogue: "Name's [event_worker]. I heard you might be looking for someone who can handle trouble. I've been fighting in underground rings for years, but I'm looking for steadier work. What do you say?"

choices.option: Offer them a trial period with reduced pay. (Potential: Discount, Trial Worker)
choices.message: You outline a short trial at [actual_cost] per day (50% discount). [event_worker] nods - for the 30-day trial they'll work at that rate while proving their worth. They gain the 'Trial Worker' trait, which will last for 30 days.

choices.option: Try to negotiate a lower wage. (50% chance: 25% discount)
choices.message_success: Your persuasive words and reasonable arguments convince [event_worker] that steady work and good treatment are worth more than high pay. 'You make a good point about job security,' they admit. They agree to work for [actual_cost] per day (25% discount).
choices.message_failure: Your negotiation attempt comes across as cheap and insulting. [event_worker]'s expression hardens. 'I know my worth. If you want me, you'll pay full price.' They still accept the position at [actual_cost] (full price), but their rebelliousness increases by +8.

choices.message: You thank [event_worker] for their interest but explain that you're not currently hiring. They nod respectfully. 'I understand. If you change your mind, you know where to find me.' They finish their drink and leave peacefully.

description: A hooded figure approaches your establishment as evening falls. Ancient tomes peek from their travel pack, and arcane symbols are embroidered on their robes. They speak in a cultured voice that hints at noble education.
dialogue:
"Greetings. I am [event_worker], a scholar of the mystical arts. I seek employment that would allow me to continue my research while contributing to your enterprise."

"My knowledge of magic and lore could prove... invaluable."

choices.message: You offer [COST] per day. [event_worker] nods gracefully. 'A fair arrangement. I accept your offer.' They extend a hand with quiet dignity. Word of your generous treatment spreads, enhancing your reputation (+8 Reputation).

choices.option: Offer above their asking price to show genuine appreciation. (Potential: Reputation, Relationship)
choices.message: You offer more than they asked for, wanting them to feel truly valued. [event_worker]'s expression softens with genuine surprise. 'You would do that? I appreciate your generosity.' They accept with [actual_cost] per day and their spirits lift noticeably. Talk of the fair wage travels through the district, raising your standing (+10 Reputation). You sense a stronger bond forming between you and Violet (+20 Relationship).

choices.option: Offer them access to your private library in exchange for reduced wages. (Potential: Discount, Relationship, Scholar's Joy)
choices.message: You sweeten the offer with library access and settle on [actual_cost] per day (20% discount). [event_worker]'s eyes brighten; knowledge is a currency they value above coin. You sense a stronger bond forming between you and Violet (+15 Relationship), and they gain the 'Scholar's Joy' trait for 90 days.

You politely explain that your establishment doesn't currently need someone with their particular skills. [event_worker] bows gracefully. 'I understand. Should your needs change, I shall be in the area for some time.' They depart with dignity intact.
